# ytimg.com
> Static asset and media delivery domain used by YouTube and Google services for images, thumbnails, icons, stylesheets, scripts, and other web resources.

ytimg.com primarily serves CDN-hosted assets rather than human-oriented documentation. It is widely used across YouTube web properties, embeds, branding surfaces, and support content to deliver static files and media resources referenced by youtube.com and related Google pages.

## Core Asset Domains
- [Main Domain](https://www.ytimg.com/): Primary host for YouTube static assets and CDN-delivered web resources.
- [Image CDN](https://i.ytimg.com/): Hosts YouTube video thumbnails, channel images, and other image assets.
- [Static Asset Path](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/): Base path for versioned YouTube web application assets.
- [Embed Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/): JavaScript bundle path used by YouTube web and embedded players.
- [Stylesheet Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/cssbin/): CSS bundle path for YouTube web interface styling resources.

## Video Thumbnail Endpoints
- [Default Thumbnail Pattern](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/): Base path for standard YouTube video thumbnail images by video ID.
- [WebP Thumbnail Pattern](https://i.ytimg.com/vi_webp/): Base path for WebP-formatted YouTube video thumbnails.
- [High Quality Thumbnail Example](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/dQw4w9WgXcQ/hqdefault.jpg): Common high-quality thumbnail URL structure for a video.
- [Maximum Resolution Thumbnail Example](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/dQw4w9WgXcQ/maxresdefault.jpg): Typical maximum-resolution thumbnail URL structure when available.
- [Medium Quality Thumbnail Example](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/dQw4w9WgXcQ/mqdefault.jpg): Typical medium-quality thumbnail URL structure.
- [Default Quality Thumbnail Example](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/dQw4w9WgXcQ/default.jpg): Typical default thumbnail URL structure.
- [WebP High Quality Example](https://i.ytimg.com/vi_webp/dQw4w9WgXcQ/hqdefault.webp): Example WebP thumbnail URL for compatible clients.

## Channel and Profile Images
- [Channel Avatar CDN](https://yt3.ggpht.com/): Google-hosted image domain commonly used for YouTube channel avatars and profile images.
- [YouTube Brand Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/img/): Static image directory for YouTube logos, icons, and interface imagery.
- [Favicon Asset](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/img/favicon_32-vflOogEID.png): Example YouTube favicon asset served from ytimg.
- [Touch Icon Asset](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/img/favicon_144-vfliLAfaB.png): Example mobile touch icon asset served from ytimg.

## Player and Embed Resources
- [Player Asset Root](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/player-en_US-vflset/): Versioned player JavaScript asset directory pattern.
- [Embed Player Script Pattern](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/www-embed-player-vflset/): Versioned embed player script directory pattern.
- [WWW Application Scripts](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/www-en_US-vflset/): Versioned main YouTube web application script directory pattern.
- [Player Stylesheets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/cssbin/player-vflset/): Versioned player stylesheet directory pattern.
- [WWW Stylesheets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/cssbin/www-main-desktop-watch-page-skeleton.css): Example stylesheet asset for YouTube desktop watch page rendering.

## Static Images and UI Assets
- [YTS Image Directory](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/img/): Root directory for YouTube interface images and icons.
- [Sprite and Icon Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/imgbin/): Versioned image bundle path used by YouTube web clients.
- [Masthead and Branding Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/imgbin/): Static image bundle path for branding and UI resources.
- [Logo Example](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/img/yt_1200-vfl4C3T0K.png): Example YouTube logo image asset.
- [Monochrome Logo Example](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/img/pixel-vfl3z5WfW.gif): Example tracking or placeholder pixel asset.

## Web App Bundles
- [JavaScript Bundle Root](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/): Root path for versioned JavaScript bundles used by YouTube clients.
- [CSS Bundle Root](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/cssbin/): Root path for versioned CSS bundles used by YouTube clients.
- [Service Worker Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/serviceworker-kevlar-appshell.js): Example service worker script for YouTube web app shell.
- [Desktop App Shell Script](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/www-i18n-constants-en_US.js): Example locale-specific constants bundle for YouTube web.
- [Polymer or Kevlar Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/desktop_polymer.js): Example modern web application bundle naming pattern.

## Internationalization and Locale Assets
- [English Locale Bundles](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/www-en_US-vflset/): Locale-specific script directory pattern for English web assets.
- [Localized Constants Example](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/www-i18n-constants-en_US.js): Example internationalization constants bundle.
- [Localized Player Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/player-en_US-vflset/): Locale-specific player asset directory pattern.
- [Localized Embed Assets](https://www.ytimg.com/yts/jsbin/www-embed-player-en_US.js): Example localized embed player script naming pattern.

## Related YouTube Properties
- [YouTube Main Site](https://www.youtube.com/): Primary consumer web application that references ytimg-hosted assets extensively.
- [YouTube Embed Endpoint](https://www.youtube.com/embed/): Embedded player endpoint that loads scripts and styles from ytimg.
- [YouTube Shorts](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/): Shorts viewing surface using shared YouTube static assets.
- [YouTube Support](https://support.google.com/youtube/): Official help center for YouTube products and features.
- [YouTube Brand Resources](https://www.youtube.com/about/brand-resources/): Official branding guidance related to YouTube marks and assets.

## Robots and Discovery
- [Robots.txt](https://www.ytimg.com/robots.txt): Crawl directives published for the ytimg static asset domain.
- [Image CDN Robots](https://i.ytimg.com/robots.txt): Crawl directives for the thumbnail and image CDN host.
- [Main Site Robots](https://www.youtube.com/robots.txt): Crawl directives for the primary YouTube web application domain.
